why: no free photo (category held only an interior)

name: Tropicana Arcos de Cristal
features: Five thin concrete arches of descending height, with glass bands between, roof the nightclub hall.

The two postcards listed as extras are coloured interior illustrations of the arch hall (PD, about 1500-1600px). Sources agree on five thin concrete shells decreasing in size with glass between, but describe them as placed eccentrically and I could not establish how they offset or step from the outside, so I did not draw it.

name: Villa Sarabhai
features: Parallel Catalan brick vaults on bearing walls, with a grass roof and a slide down into the pool.
why: No free photo on Commons; the one CC BY 2.0 file found shows the family's 'Retreat' gardens (913px). A CC0 model photo exists (File:薩拉拜別墅模型.jpg, 4096x2304), but it shows no vaults and its accuracy is doubtful, so it isn't listed as an extra. Sources confirm parallel Catalan brick vaults open at their ends onto verandahs, a planted roof garden, and a one-piece concrete slide from the first-floor terrace into the pool with a zigzag stair. They don't give the number of vault bays or where the first-floor part and slide sit along the facade, so I didn't draw it.

name: Villaggio ENI, Borca di Cadore
